description.value: A beachfront resort on the Strait of Georgia between Qualicum Beach and Parksville, offering a range of oceanfront suites, cottages, and a private vacation home with direct beach access. The setting is a secluded beachfront where guests can beachcomb, dig clams, fish for salmon, and observe marine wildlife including bald eagles and seals. The resort is also well-placed as a base for exploring Vancouver Island cycling and outdoor destinations, including mountain biking at Mt. Washington and trails near Cathedral Grove.
